sn22.73:1.2: Assutavā bhikkhave puthujjano rūpassa assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtaṃ na pajānāti || || 4-6
sn22.73:1.6: Viññāṇassa assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇam ca yathābhūtam na pajānāti || || 8-12
sn22.73:1.7: Sutavā ca kho bhikkhave ariyasāvako Rūpassa ||
sn22.73:1.11: Viññāṇassa assādañca ādinavañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtam pajānātīti || || 1-2
